edits.model_reason: Corrects the phrasing to match the source's identification of two distinct questions: the necessity of notice for pre-TPA leases and the propriety of interfering with discretionary refusal of relief.
Clarifies the mapping of survey numbers. The source states 86/1 and 86/2 correspond to Old 71. The draft previously implied a direct 1-to-1 or ambiguous correspondence with both old numbers.
Adds the detail that only Defendant No. 1 appealed and specifies the modification terms (three months) and the court's stance on interference with discretion.
Removes the inferred phrase 'applicable to pre-TPA leases' from the HC's holding on notice, sticking closer to the quoted text. Clarifies the standard for interfering with discretion.
